whatIs: Fontjoy generates Google Fonts pairings with one click. A deep learning model looks for fonts that go well together without looking too similar, and you can change the sample text to see how the heading and body look.
It's a good fit when you don't know which fonts to combine and want quick ideas: you lock the one you like and regenerate the rest until you land on a pair that works.
uses: Finding a body font to go with a landing page heading.
Starting from a brand's font and exploring what to pair it with.
Trying out a real paragraph from your project with several pairs before choosing.
caveats: It's an idea generator: the pairings are partly random, so check the result yourself.
It works only with Google Fonts, so it's no use if your brand uses a commercial typeface.
It only suggests the pair: afterward you have to load the fonts from Google Fonts in your project.
pricingNote: Free to use, with no paid plans.
idealFor: Anyone who needs quick ideas for font pairings.
